The API key is passed in header or query param. We need to construct the request. The user didn't specify the base URL; we can assume https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3. We need to return the related object's IDs and context attributes. The response will be JSON with data array. Each item has id, type, attributes, relationships, etc. We need to extract id and context attributes. Context attributes might be in attributes.context_attributes.
